description:
Your coding agents don't stop when you leave the desk, so neither should you. Tailscode puts every agent running on your own computers in your pocket: Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, opencode and Oh My Pi, plus any agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol, on any model they can run, including one on your own graphics card. Start a task from the couch, check on six at once from anywhere, and get a ping when the long one finishes. Your chats go straight to your machines over your own Tailscale network, never through a relay, with no sign-in. Free and open source.

ONE COMMAND TO SET UP
For Claude Code, one line on the computer you code on installs the bridge and ends with a QR code. Scan it, confirm, and the app has your machine; opencode has a one-line installer too. Want to look first? A built-in demo shows the main screens with no server at all.

HERMES AND ANY ACP AGENT
• Hermes, Gemini CLI, Codex, goose and the rest of the ACP registry run through the bridge already on your machine, each proved with a real chat before it counts as ready.
• Hermes with no model gets one in a tap from the model server your machine already runs. It sits in the model pill beside Claude.
• Hold Send to ask later, or type when: weekdays 7:30. Your machine asks with your phone off, remembers the last run and stays quiet when nothing changed.

EVERY AGENT AT A GLANCE
• Home is one ranked board: a sentence that says who needs you and what is working, then the chats waiting on you, working, pinned and recent.
• The Agents board shows what needs you, what is working, what runs in the background and what finished in the last hour, with approve and answer on each card. Watch turns it into a full-screen wall of every agent.

ANY MODEL, EVEN YOUR OWN GPU
• Whatever your agent can run, from cloud models to a local model served by Ollama or llama.cpp on your own machine, picked per chat with its reasoning effort.
• Carry a conversation to another model: the next one gets a short brief of the chat and picks up the thread.
• A party of six favourite models and their effort levels, one tap or one swipe of the model pill away.

LONG RUNS, NO BABYSITTING
• A Live Activity on your Lock Screen for a running conversation, one for each with Pro: what it is doing, for how long, and how many tools it has run.
• Notifications say how long a turn took and what it changed. Reply from the Lock Screen; an approval shows the exact command and asks for Face ID.
• Queue the next message while a turn runs, edit it before it goes, or stop the turn on the server.

A NATIVE TRANSCRIPT, NOT A TERMINAL
• Megatron folds a turn's thinking and tool runs into one head you open to read, search and replay every step.
• Diffs, commands and their real output inline; syntax-highlighted code with byte-exact copy.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
• Every conversation priced, every month totalled across machines, by model, project and tool. Always an estimate, never a bill.
• Plan limits and quotas per provider and account, with the pace and turns left, on Home and in widgets.

YOURS, END TO END
• Your chats travel point to point over your tailnet, never through a relay. No sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and your code and conversations never reach us.
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, plus a Linux desktop app, all open source under GPL-3.0: the app, the engine and the bridges.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core on one server: full chat, the Agents and Home boards, approvals, attachments, every model, a Live Activity at a time. Tailscode Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: unlimited servers in one list, concurrent Live Activities, iPhone and Mac on the same Apple Account, and the delegate board.

Tailscode is independent open-source software, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Nous Research, Tailscale Inc., the opencode project or Oh My Pi.

Privacy policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/tailscode/privacy
Source code: https://github.com/guitaripod/Tailscode
promotionalText: Claude Code, Codex, opencode and Hermes on your own computer, from your phone. Start a task, approve from the Lock Screen, come back to finished work. No sign-in.
whatsNew:
Masters, a terminal on your own machine, and Outer Rim.

New:
• Masters (beta): give a Claude Code machine a standing role with a charter, skills, a notebook and checks the machine proves. Each task is a fresh chat briefed with all of it and ends in a debrief whose notebook changes you accept or skip. With claude-bridge 1.38.
• A terminal: your login shell on the computer, with a bar of the keys the on-screen keyboard lacks. The shell stays on the machine, so it is still there after you close the app or switch devices. With claude-bridge 1.38 or omp-bridge 0.19.
• Outer Rim, a theme that is a place: a starfield behind the chat and every signal a coloured blade. New installs start in it.
• A new prompt box: it grows a line at a time, fades a long draft into its edge and lifts to the whole page from its handle. @ lists the project's files with changed ones first, Send shows whether it sends, queues, stops or saves, and the + adds Take Photo and Scan Text.
• Quiet at your desk: while a Mac or Linux Tailscode sees you at the computer, the phone holds its notices and Live Activities until you leave, and a notice goes away once its chat is read anywhere. With claude-bridge 1.34 or omp-bridge 0.18.
• Live Activities look like Agents wall tiles, with the plan, latest steps and model, and follow turns started on a desktop, from a queue or on a schedule.
• The Agents board is one press away: Home's bar, the iPad sidebar, Control Center, the Lock Screen, the Action Button and Siri. Each wall tile wears an emblem for its model.
• Pictures open from where they sit, gather in one strip under their turn, and only the ones the agent names are shown. A long prompt folds.
• Home holds every chat, twenty more at a time, with Mark all as read across every server. Masters and quotas sit behind one row of buttons.
• A message written offline waits and goes on its own when the machine answers, even after a relaunch.
• Unread chats are easy to spot and each row says what happened.
• First run asks which agent runs on your computer and opens on its install command.
• iPad: the conversation gets the width it needs, and the list's search, New chat, Allow once and the jump to the end sit under your thumbs.

Fixes:
• After the phone restarted, Tailscode could open as a fresh install with no servers and no Pro. It now waits for the first unlock.
• A usage window whose reset time has passed no longer reads as used up.
• Opening a chat, typing and sending are faster, most of all on older iPhones.
• The icon's number counts only chats with news, and old chats no longer light up as unread.
• The Lock Screen keeps at most five Tailscode cards and always has room for the chat you are using.
• A background command finishing is a quiet note, not a message in your voice.
